explanation: This component only turns on at the GO step, when the agent chooses a2 right after a trial that was rewarded in S2. That is usually a2 to S2 common, which gives about 8-10 late in the episode (trial 60 and on), about 4-6 around trials 35-55, and 2-4 if the reward in S2 came after a rare a1 transition. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at every a1 choice, after any unrewarded trial, and after any reward in S1, including a2 that went rare to S1 and was rewarded.
